response.justification: Bogdan has well over the required 6 years of full-stack experience (15+ years across web, mobile, embedded), with recent, directly relevant work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes. Notably, his current role explicitly includes AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which maps to the hard-to-source 'AI agent development' requirement. He also brings strong engineering-craft credentials (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, authored test runners and assertion libraries) plus a CS degree and demonstrated communication skills via workshops and conference talks. Main gaps are the absence of explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest and Kotlin experience, and a heavy investment in the niche D language rather than the target stack — but these are learnable adjacencies for someone with his breadth. Worth an interview to probe depth in modern TypeScript backend frameworks and testing tooling.
strengths: Hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling work matching a key requirement
Strong testing and craftsmanship track record (TDD, CI/CD, built test frameworks)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest experience listed
Kotlin absent and Java/Python exposure appears dated or limited
Significant focus on niche DLang ecosystem over the target stack

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js, Vitest, and Kotlin specifics
